01 / The mindset

Independent thinking.

Challenging accepted paradigms and conventional wisdom, thinking critically and creatively, problem-solving and independence of mindset. Independent thinking is fundamental to the University of Sheffield experience.

02 / The collective

Shared ambition.

Collaboration and unity, belonging and community, respect for difference with the commitment to the delivery of a common goal. Shared ambition is at the heart of our University.

03 / WHO WE ARE

Independent thinking.Shared ambition.

Distinct from one another, independent thinking and shared ambition are clear strengths. But together they have the power to transform lives and shape the world we live in.

01 / 03

This is the brand proposition that represents who we are and what we stand for as an organisation – a world top 100 university where independent thinkers come together in pursuit of a shared ambition.

SHARED AMBITIONS

Powering a net-zero future.

Discover how Sheffield researchers are helping to build a cleaner energy future.

Dr Karen Finney and Sustainable Aviation Fuel testing

At the Energy Innovation Centre, Dr Finney and her team test and certify sustainable fuels at pilot-scale, helping industry move closer to a cleaner, low-carbon future.

Professor Meihong Wang and solar-powered aviation fuel

Using fields of mirrors to harness sunlight and capture CO₂ from the air, Professor Wang is pioneering a new way to produce Sustainable Aviation Fuel without relying on fossil fuels.

Professor Dan Gladwin and battery storage

Operating one of the UK’s largest grid-scale energy storage test facilities, Professor Gladwin is transforming how we store and use renewable energy.
